verdict.rationale: A business-filing portal could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring filings, so this axis applies. However, the evidence shows only interactive online, mail, and in-person filing and search; it documents no user-configurable automations, background jobs, or recurring schedules. Bulk data files and ballot-status notifications are adjacent features, not user-defined autonomous automations, and the probes found no API or OpenAPI spec to build them on.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
